install_cmds: python -c "import torch, numpy, PIL; print('image-matting deps: torch', torch.__version__, 'numpy', numpy.__version__)"

data_deps.name: image_matting_composites
data_deps.description: REAL trimap-guided image-matting dataset built from PPM-100 (Photographic Portrait Matting: real Flickr portrait photos + real, hand-refined alpha mattes; HF mirror https://huggingface.co/datasets/realdream-ai/ppm-matting), 90 train / 10 val samples, cropped to a padded bbox of the alpha region and resized to 160x160. Each sample is a REAL composite photo I with its REAL GT alpha; foreground (F) and background (B) colour layers are synthesized from the SAME real photo via cv2.inpaint (TELEA) so I = a*F + (1-a)*B holds essentially exactly outside the unknown transition band (reconstruction error ~1e-3 overall). The harness re-derives a trimap (definite-fg / definite-bg / UNKNOWN band) from the real GT alpha at eval time at THREE band widths (6/9/12 = the medium/wide/xwide difficulty settings each task's score gmeans over), so the standard matting metrics (SAD / MSE / gradient error, all measured ONLY in the trimap unknown band, lower is better) are computed on genuine real-photo alpha transitions at three difficulties. Used by the trimap-guided alpha-matte cv-matting-* tasks (soft alpha regression, distinct from segmentation). Downloaded once from the HF mirror and cached; requires network access + opencv on the HOST at prepare time (see host_data_prepare_requirements).
